pages.text: A mid-game generator built in a row: an induction $(l)boiler$() burns Biogas or Methane into steam, $(l)1 to 4 cylinders$() turn it into motion and a $(l)dynamo$() at the end turns the flywheel into FE.

$(li)Place the $(l)Steam Engine$() (the boiler). Its front faces you.$(br)$(li)Behind it, in a straight line, place $(l)1 to 4 Steam Engine Cylinders$().$(br)$(li)Close the row with a $(l)Steam Engine Dynamo$().$(br)When the row is complete its blocks turn into $(l)one machine$(): a white
pages.title: Building it

pages.text: induction boiler with glowing orange coils and steam puffing from its top, a cylinder for every block with its piston pumping in a glass sleeve, the steam line running over them, and the dynamo with copper windings and a spinning flywheel. The faster the engine runs, the brighter the coils and windings glow.
The GUI shows a live side view of the engine, the cylinders found, the power made and the speed.
Pipe Biogas or Methane into the boiler. $(l)Each cylinder$() burns $(l)15 mB/t$():$(br)$(li)$(l)Biogas$(): 6, 90 FE/t, 360 FE/t$(br)$(li)$(l)Methane$(): 10, 150 FE/t, 600 FE/t
pages.title: Fuel and power

pages.text: A full engine on methane burns 60 mB/t, the gas of two or three zombie chambers, and makes as much as fifteen Combustion Generators; a $(l:nuclear/fission_reactor)Fission Reactor$(/l) still makes more.
The engine needs about $(l)5 seconds$() to reach full speed and slows down when the fuel runs out. It stops burning fuel when its buffer (200,000 FE) is full.
The power comes out of the $(l)dynamo$(): connect $(l:cables/energy_conduit)Energy Conduits$(/l) or machines to it. Pipes and cables joining the boiler or the dynamo get a collar with a cyan ring.
